verification: The NEXT Medical Festival's own speaker announcement and a networkpharma.tv recording of the 'Plug in to Medical NEXT' panel name her as 'Global Scientific Communication Lead, RSV mAb at Sanofi'. A separate LinkedIn post by Benoit De Nayer says 'Caroline Chataing explains how @Sanofi combines #CRM and #AI to boost HCP engagement' at the Digital Pharma Summit, which matches a Sanofi digital and medical role. The only LinkedIn profile a search returns for the name is a different person (a Club Med lawyer, Caroline Chataing-Deguiraud) and was rejected.

# Plug in to Medical NEXT: Navigating Complexity, Driving Impact!

Posted 4th February 2026

**This video was not produced by NetworkPharma.tv but has been included within the library because it is directly relevant to our audience and is here with permission from its owner.**

*= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =*

NEXT Medical Festival was held 28-29 January 2026 in Brussels, Belgium.

This was an exclusive two-day festival and gathering for 100 bold Medical Affairs leaders. Through Oxford debates, real-world case studies, and collaborative workshops, we’ll challenge the status quo in Medical engagement, AI, and cross-functional collaboration. No panels. Just action, ideas, and impact.

In this session, we hear from:

**Joaquim Fonseca** – Global Medical Excellence Lead at Takeda  
**Michelle Bridenbaker** – Global Head of Medical Excellence & Communications at Recordati  
**Caroline Chataing** – Global Scientific Communication Lead – RSV mAb at Sanofi  
**Dario Safaric** – CEO at NEXT Pharma Summit

**Recorded at a live meeting, 28 January 2026 by Next Pharma and is included here with their permission.**

Joaquim’s LinkedIn page is at <https://www.linkedin.com/in/joaquim-fonseca/>

Michelle’s LinkedIn page is at <https://www.linkedin.com/in/michelle-bridenbaker/>

Caroline’s LinkedIn page is at <https://www.linkedin.com/in/caroline-chataing/>

Dario’s LinkedIn page is at <https://www.linkedin.com/in/dariosafaric/>

To find out more about future NEXT Pharma events visit <https://nextpharmasummit.com/>

**NOTE: Sharing this content has been facilitated by Closing Delta, official media partner to NEXT PHARMA.** To find out more about Closing Delta visit <https://closingdelta.com/>

>NEXT Medical Festival – SPEAKER ANNOUNCEMENT 🟣> We’re pleased to welcome Caroline Chataing, Scientific Engagement and Medical Transformation Lead – General Medicines, North Europe at [Sanofi](https://fr.linkedin.com/company/sanofi?trk=public_post-text), to the first-ever NEXT Medical Festival. Caroline brings a strong and hands-on Medical Affairs journey, with experience spanning scientific engagement, medical transformation, customer engagement, and global scientific communications. Her path through [Sanofi](https://fr.linkedin.com/company/sanofi?trk=public_post-text) — from BeLux Medical Advisor roles to leading Medical Transformation across North Europe — reflects a deep understanding of how medical strategy, engagement, and execution come together in practice. With a background rooted in pharmacy, hospital practice, and medical engagement, Caroline combines scientific rigor with a modern, transformation-driven mindset, helping shape how General Medicines teams engage meaningfully with stakeholders across markets. We’re excited to have Caroline contribute her perspective on scientific engagement and medical transformation in Brussels. Thank you, Caroline, for joining the first-ever NEXT Medical Festival — we can’t wait for your insights in Brussels! 💜
